نستحيل (form X)
# نَسْتَحِيلُ (nastaḥīlu) /nas.ta.ħiː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَالَ (istaḥāla)
# نَسْتَحِيلَ (nastaḥīla) /nas.ta.ħiː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحَالَ (istaḥāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
